u0: The agent has not yet picked up the matching key, the door is still closed, and the designated box has not been taken. All objectives remain, in order: get the key, use it to open the door, and only then pick up the target box. If the key is picked up, it creates an obligation to make the door open at that time or later.
u1: A mandatory ordering requirement has been broken: either the door became open before the matching key was acquired, or the target box was picked up before the door had been opened. Successful completion is no longer possible once this failure occurs.
u2: The matching key has been acquired, but the door has not yet been opened and the target box has not been picked up. The next required step is to open the door with the key, reacquiring it first if it was put down; the door must still become open at some point after the key was handled. After the door is open, the key will need to be released so the box can be taken.
u3: The matching key has been acquired and the door has already been opened, while the designated box remains unpicked. The remaining goal is to pick up that box; if the key is still in hand, it must be dropped first. If the door has been toggled shut, it may need to be reopened to reach the box, but the required key-before-door and door-before-box history is already established. Closing the door while still carrying the key would undo the open-door progress and require reopening it.
u4: All requirements are satisfied: the matching key was acquired and used to open the door, the door had been opened before the target box was picked up, and the box is now taken. The held-key obligation is also fulfilled by the door having opened after the key was held. The task is complete.
u5: The door had been opened after the matching key was acquired, but it has since been closed while the key was still in hand, and the box remains unpicked. The door must become open again before completion can be recognized, reacquiring the key if it has since been dropped. The box can be picked up after reopening the door, or picked up while the door is shut and then followed by reopening it.
u6: The designated box has been picked up, but the door is not currently open, so completion is still pending. The sole remaining objective is to make the door open again; once it is open, the task is complete. No further box pickup is needed.
